unusual_experiment.name: PHYSICAL_SQLITE_STATE_TRUNCATION_REOPEN
unusual_experiment.purpose: Falsify the possibility that a physically truncated authoritative UnifiedDB silently reinitializes or rewrites state on reopen.
unusual_experiment.intervention: Create valid persisted state and checkpoint, close, truncate the SQLite file to 50 percent, then reopen through the exact current UnifiedDB constructor.
unusual_experiment.observed_exception: sqlite3.DatabaseError: database disk image is malformed
unusual_experiment.replication_rule: The committed regression is replay-only and adds zero unusual experiments.

isolated_regression.scope_limit: Auxiliary isolated regression evidence; not whole-container or Vercel Sandbox acceptance.
